about:
Beijing-based Panther Healthcare Medical Equipment Co., Ltd. was founded in 2002 as a subsidiary of ITG Health Technology, which is controlled by Xiamen ITG Group Corp., Ltd. (stock code: 600755), a core enterprise of the Fortune Global 500 conglomerate Xiamen ITG Holding Group. The company positions itself as a leading provider of intelligent minimally invasive surgical solutions in China.

Panther manufactures a comprehensive portfolio of minimally invasive surgical products, including endoscopic staplers, smart staplers, open staplers, ultrasonic scalpels, disposable fixation devices for hernia repair, polymer clips, trocars, and the Panther Ultraseal system. The company also distributes sutures, hernia meshes, and blood vessel titanium clips produced by third parties, and provides OEM manufacturing for certain products. Its devices serve gastrointestinal, gynecologic, thoracic, and bariatric surgical specialties, and are exported to more than 80 countries, with the firm claiming the top export sales ranking among Chinese surgical stapler brands for ten consecutive years from 2016 to 2025.

The company serves hospitals, surgeons, and distributors worldwide, with noted markets including the United States, Germany, Brazil, India, and South Korea. In addition to product supply, Panther operates the Panther Surgical Academy, which organizes surgical trainings, master classes, and clinical immersions globally.

Panther emphasizes an integrated product offering that combines its own manufactured staplers and energy devices with complementary third-party accessories, aiming to provide a one-stop solution for minimally invasive procedures. The firm also highlights its OEM capabilities and global training initiatives as differentiators.
